That cure of life, shall whisper of poison.

The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother releases March 18, 2027 on PlayStation®5. 
Pre-order now!

The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother is the first-ever console game adaptation of the popular franchise "The Apothecary Diaries", featuring a brand-new story conceptualized by series author Hyuganatsu.

Two chains of strange phenomenon and conspiracies are causing chaos throughout the rear palace, red-light district, and streets of the capital. Apothecary Maomao must use every ounce of her intelligence and knowledge to solve the mysteries and unveil the truth behind the False Imperial Brother before it destroys the imperial court.

Unlock new rewards with the Season Two Tamriel Tome, Golden Pursuit campaigns, and in-game events, and enjoy the next wave of player-experience improvements—Tamriel awaits! 

ESO’s Season Two is live from October 21, 2026, until January 27, 2027.

Halloween comes to HEAT, the free-to-play tactical shooter. Earn Halloween rewards just by playing from October 21 to November 4. 

Complete weekly Halloween missions to earn Intel and unlock Pumpkin Head outfits, ghost-print tank skins, a camouflage for every vehicle and the Jack-o'-Lantern charm. 

The Inferno One map dresses up for the occasion in all of its modes. From October 23 to 26, the Halloween Chase adds solo and squad leaderboards that reset every few hours, with Halloween rewards for the top finishers. 

Download and play for free on PS5®!

description:
Ordinary Oddness is a Nothing-Stays-Oddinary Open-World RPG. Since the Albinox Judgment, humans and Mythoids have lived side by side in Elysian Skies, a city suspended above a sea of clouds, sharing the same streets and the same everyday rules.

Elysian Skies is now open for registration to all humans and Mythoids. As a Consulting Investigator certified by the Mythoids Investigation Agency, you'll open an agency on Breezeway Lane and take on commissions from humans and Mythoids alike. Rules will break, daily life will warp, and the truth isn't always comforting, but this city welcomes you back, oddball.
